SLT Line 3840L is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Prymea (Fare Zone 26) . It currently has 5 stops.

  • 5 Gallery

Description []

SLT Line 3840L is a line that runs within the Lowwwind vicinity of Prymea near Borealis.

This line is Line Number 3840L in the SLT system, and is represented by Sky Blue (The representative color of Borealis Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line currently runs entirely within Prymea, as the vicinity of Prymea is developed by the developer of Borealis and has plans to extend into Borealis in the future, it is considered part of the Borealis SLT network.
  • The route of this line overlaps entirely with Line 3830L. However, while this line runs in the clockwise direction, Line 3830L runs in the counter-clockwise direction.

Description[]

SLT Line 401 mainly serves the Media City Sub-District of Flask.

This line is Line Number 401 in the SLT system, and is represented by Brown (The representative color of Flask Fare Zone).

SLT Line 402 runs from the north to the south of Flask. It passes through Flask North, Media City Sub-Districts and Medium Lake before ending at Flask South.

This line is Line Number 402 in the SLT system, and is represented by Brown (The representative color of Flask Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line 411 runs around the Medium Lake in Flask.

Description[]

SLT Line 412 runs around the Medium Lake in Flask.

This line is Line Number 412 in the SLT system, and is represented by Brown (The representative color of Flask Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

SLT Line 501 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas West Metropolis Archipelago (Fare Zone 5). This line currently has 4 stops, and runs between Caver Island and Heeled Bay.

Description[]

SLT Line 501 runs along the west of West Metropolis Archipelago between Heeled Island and Caver Island.

This line is Line Number 501 in the SLT system, and is represented by Blue (The representative color of West Metropolis Archipelago Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line 501L is a circular line that runs within Heeled Island of West Metropolis Archipelago and is currently 1.31km long.

This line is Line Number 501L in the SLT system, and is represented by Blue (The representative color of West Metropolis Archipelago Fare Zone).

SLT Line 502 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit between Los Sengas West Metropolis Archipelago (Fare Zone 5) and Peckern (Fare Zone 7). This line currently has 5 stops, and runs between Caver Island and Beak Beach.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 502 runs from the Caver Island of West Metropolis Archipelago, passes through Stem Island, Kneeling Island and Dark Pearl Island, before arriving at Beak Beach in Peckern District.

This line is Line Number 502 in the SLT system, and is represented by Blue (The representative color of West Metropolis Archipelago Fare Zone).

SLT Line 510L is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas West Metropolis Archipelago (Fare Zone 5). This line circles Heeled Island in a counter-clockwise direction, and starts at Sanfo Farms.

Contents

  • 6 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 510L is a circular line that runs within Sanfo Island of West Metropolis Archipelago and is currently 1.39km long.

This line is Line Number 510L in the SLT system, and is represented by Blue (The representative color of West Metropolis Archipelago Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is dubbed by the owner of Sanfo Island as "Sanfo Ring Line".

SLT Line 511L was a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas West Metropolis Archipelago (Fare Zone 5). This line circles Hatace Island, and starts at Hatace Estate Stop. Currently, this line is demolished due to island owner personnel change.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 History
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 511L was a circular line that runs within Hatace Island of West Metropolis Archipelago.

This line was Line Number 511L in the SLT system, and is represented by Blue (The representative color of West Metropolis Archipelago Fare Zone).

History[]

  • June 23 2016: SLT 511L was established to become second light rail system served in Hatace Island. Two light rail system are planned to interchange each other twice, one of which is Hatace Estate Stop.
  • Unknown: Due to refurbishment and personnel change of Hatace Island, the line was demolished.

Rolling Stock[]

Line 511L used Minecart throughout.

SLT Line 811 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Peckern (Fare Zone 7).[1] This line currently has 5 stops, and runs between Whitesilk and Polywood.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 811 runs along the west of Peckern.

This line is Line Number 811 in the SLT system, and is represented by Dark Green (The representative color of Peckern North Fare Zone).

SLT Line 813 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Peckern (Fare Zone 7).[1] This line currently has two sections totalling 10 stops, with the west section running between Richland Building and Lisa Lake, and the east section running between Barbecue Site Four and Peckern Bay Block 6.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 813 runs along the Purple Gate, Purplaetus and Peckern areas of Peckern.

This line is Line Number 813 in the SLT system, and is represented by Dark Green (The representative color of Peckern North Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line INN-01 is a line that runs along the south coast of Intus Aquilo Island.

This line is Line Number INN-01 in the SLT system, and is represented by Yellow-Green (The representative color of Intus Aquilo Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line INN-02 is a line that runs along the west coast of Intus Aquilo Island.

This line is Line Number INN-02 in the SLT system, and is represented by Yellow-Green (The representative color of Intus Aquilo Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line INN-03 is a line that runs along the east coast of Intus Aquilo Island.

This line is Line Number INN-03 in the SLT system, and is represented by Yellow-Green (The representative color of Intus Aquilo Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line INN-04 is a line that runs from the Densewood vicinity to the coast at the south of Intus Aquilo Island.

This line is Line Number INN-04 in the SLT system, and is represented by Yellow-Green (The representative color of Intus Aquilo Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line INN-08 is a line that runs from the Densewood vicinity to the coast at the north of Intus Aquilo Island.

This line is Line Number INN-08 in the SLT system, and is represented by Yellow-Green (The representative color of Intus Aquilo Fare Zone).

Passengers may also use this station to change to PTT. Railway Greenwood Line (Smelting Bay Station) and Nawis Railway Snow White Line (Smelting Bay Station).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Confluence of the Inner Lands".

Fun Facts[]

  • The color scheme of this station alludes to the theme of this station as red is associated with high temperatures in Infrared Radiation.[2]
  • To allude to the theme of this station, barbecue resting areas featuring furnaces are set up at the Urban Line Concourse.
  • Due to miscommunication between the Oasis Bay developer and Nazca, Pegasus Line did not extend to this station in S3E16 as planned.[3]
  • Exit F3 is not added to this station until the Pegasus Line expansion.[4]

History[]

  • October 3 2018: The Platform Structure and Electromechanical Systems of this station completed construction.[5]
  • October 4 2018: This Station completed construction.
  • October 6 2018:This station began services alongside Urban Line.
  • July 22 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • December 9 2021: This station began expansion of the Wanderer Line Part.
  • December 10 2021: This station completed the expansion of the Wanderer Line Part.[7]
  • December 15 2021: Wanderer Line is established.
  • April 27 2022: This station began and completed the expansion of the Pegasus Line Part.
  • April 28 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Snipe Valley Station to this station.
  • March 17 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[8]

History[]

  • March 29 2021: This stop began construction.
  • March 30 2021: This stop completed construction.
  • April 1 2021: This stop began services alongside Tsing Lam Line, but Sheung Yam Line and Pak Kei Line have yet to begin services.
  • April 3 2021: Pak Kei Line is established.
  • April 25 2021: Kashiwazaki Road Stop began services. Pak Kei Line extended from Wah Hon Estate Stop to this stop through Kashiwazaki Road Stop and is now connected with the section between this stop and Sexterade Pier Head Stop.
  • May 7 2021: Sheung Yam Line extended from Yam Ling Court Stop to this stop.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was not originally a part of S3E12, as the developer of Oasis Bay had already developed a town at that vicinity, a station is added at that area to enhance the convenience of transport.[3]
  • This Station was originally planned to solely serve Echo Line. However, at the time of the construction of this station, the Strategic Line Project was already under planning, with the area of this station being a feasible development area of the Strategic Line Project. As a result, reserved platforms for Pegasus Line are already bulit upon construction of this station.
  • The layout of Glaciss Station alludes to this station.

History[]

  • August 3 2020: This station began services alongside Echo Line, but Pegasus Line platforms remain reserved.
  • April 5 2022: This station completed setting up of Pegasus Line systems.[4]
  • April 8 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Up Clearings Station to this station through Everbond Station.
  • August 4 2022: After two years, Exit C of this station is open to the public. At the same day, Exit F is added to this station to connect to the Valleyplaza Bus Terminal at the ground level.[5]
  • March 28 2024: Epsilon Line is renamed Echo Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station corresponds to Snowless Valley Station in Terracept Division. However, while Snowless Valley Station is located near a valley filled with snow, this station is located near a valley without snow.[2]
  • The Reverse Basic PSDs is used at Platforms 1, 4 of this station to reserve the spaciousness of the Platforms.

Snowman Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is connected to Hatace Island with Snowman Bridge.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 External Access
    • 2.2 Railways
  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

Snowman Isle is located at the east of West Metropolis Archipelago and the southwest of Hatace Island. This isle is named after the fact that this isle looks like a snowman.

Transport[]

External Access[]

  • Snowman Bridge (Connect to Hatace Island)

Railways[]

As the Regulations for Highly Permitted Island Development forbids any motor roads and railways on isles, plans for the Hatace Island Light Rail to connect to this isle were scrapped. As a result, the Snowman Bridge remains the only external access to and from this isle.

Description[]

Snowty Line is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

This route is represented by Rose Red on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 26.

This line is 17.745 km long, and has a total of 11 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to feature Station-Exclusive Menus which were first mentioned in the Introduction Video of Season 2, Episode 11.[2]
  • The Staircase between the Ground Concourse and the Concourse, as well as the Staircase between the Concourse and the Waiting Concourse, both adopt a crowd control pattern.
  • The design of this Station alludes to Ribera Harbor Station, which is also an interchange Station of Urban Line and Aquilo Circuit. The Corresponding Characteristics of the two stations are as follows:

South Bay Station is a station on West Ring Line and Urban Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 101 (South Bay NR Station Stop).

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0.5
  • Two Players Needed
  • While one of the players need to find the secret passageway leading to the rooftop, the other player must find a place to press a button to open the door that leads to the rooftop.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a chest.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Moment
    • Hit-and-run

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Look at the four pillars at the west side of the station that has different wool colors with a numbered sign on it.

Fun Facts[]

  • The access to the Station Gauntlet Area of this station is neither located at the Platforms nor the Concourse of this station. Instead, it is located at the south of the station. This marks the first instance in which the Station Gauntlet Entrance is not located within the main structure of the station.

History[]

  • May 30 2015: This station began services.
  • May 12 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • August 3 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • July 23 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • September 13 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • August 28 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[8]

title: South Bay Terminal
safeHtml:
South Bay Terminal is one of the piers of Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals. It is located at Los Sengas Downtown.

Description[]

  • Terminal Number: 1
  • Location: Los Sengas Downtown South Bay
  • Color Scheme: Orange, Cyan
  • Land Area: 100.9 Hectares
  • Coast Length: 2.751 km
  • Number of Containers: 133,228
  • Number of Cranes: 32
  • Connecting Stations: West Ring Line, Urban Line South Bay Station, SLT Line 101 South Bay NR Station Stop

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • The first terminal built in Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.
  • This terminal has the longest coast length among the Container Terminals.
  • Completed alongside West Ring Line, Urban Line South Bay Station.

South Field Station is a station on Swift Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 212 South Field NR Station Stop, where passengers can in turn travel to Desert Field NR Station Stop and change to Nazca Railway Urban Line (Desert Field Station) and Downtown Transit Sirius Line (Desert Field Station)

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after the fact that it is situated to the south of Desert Field Station. This station was set up due to the lack of available space for Swift Line to change with Urban Line at ground level of Desert Field Station due to the existance of Urban Line and Urban Express tracks.[2]

Future Development[]

  • Exit E will be added to this station to provide a more direct connection between this station and South Field NR Station Stop.[3]

History[]

  • January 7 2021: This Station began services.
